findings.title: shrink: planning guidance tables asserted 111 exact phrases plus a per-phrase negative-control loop
findings.detail: Round 1. Exact-wording checks that break on harmless rewording.
findings.reason: Tables trimmed to 48 unique short anchors; the loop was replaced by one removal case and one moved-out-of-section case asserting exactly two section errors. Round-2 review confirmed.

findings.title: Placement-negative assertions tested text position without a requirement
findings.reason: Both negative assertions were removed; the ordering assertion and the positive Phase 1 assertion remain.

findings.title: Sidecar orchestrator step 2 decisive-assumption sentence was ambiguous
findings.reason: Now: 'When you write the plan yourself, first check each decisive assumption as the workflow rule describes.' Test anchored on 'decisive assumption'.

findings.title: Requirement-map trigger differed between planner, plan-big template, and plan-decomposition
findings.reason: All surfaces now say the requirements spec template is for requirements spanning several artifacts and the requirement map is for requirements spanning several phases; the sidecar plan-big names only the map.
